newsitem.title: USA: Brazil coffee freeze risk next week 20% - Cropcast.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee freeze risk next week 20% - Cropcast.

text.p: Weather forecaster Cropcast said Thursday the latest long-range guidance models continued to show signs of cold weather reaching Brazil's coffee belt next week, with the probability of a freeze set at 20 percent.

"At this time, it appears that the greatest threat of a freeze will be from the 8th to the 10th of August," Cropcast said in its daily weather summery. "Given the extended nature of this forecast, the probability of a freeze across the coffee belt is being put at only 20 percent.
It added, "We will continue to monitor this situation very closely."

In its extended outlook, Cropcast said the latest long-range model guidance suggested that an area of 1036 mb high pressure centered over Buenos Aires, Argentina, on Aug 6 could ridge northward over the southern half of Brazil late next week, with pressures as high as 1028 mb extending as far northward as Parana and southern Sao Paulo by Aug 8.

However, forecaster Weather Services Corp said in its daily update on Thursday that colder air expected to build into Central Argentina next week does not appear strong enough at this time to penetrate northward into Brazil's coffee belt.
